alex (oncall): taking over from @maria for the 2200-0200 shift. theres an active incident (error spike on hosted inference) that was paged earlier. im online now — who wants to be comms owner and whos secondary during the handoff? i can drive mitigation but want someone on external updates and billing impact check.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • P1 • hosted-inference: elevated 5xx rate (>15% avg) • affected customers: some high-throughput tenants • links: https://redwood.incidents/1779994321 • runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-inference-spike
maria (handoff): handing off. alex, ill stay as secondary for ~10-15m to finish logs + notes then drop to watch. primary: you. comms: need someone to craft a short external note (status page + slack comms).
alex (oncall): copying runbook now. opening bridge in 60s: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1779994321. ill take mitigation owner. @lee want comms?
lee (sre-comm): ill take comms. ill draft status and post to status.redwood and customer channels. give me the short impact bullets and any ETA guesses.
sam (infra): ill be on infra contact for GPU pools and autoscale. if its routing related ill look at the placement logs.
alex (oncall): ok owners: mitigation=alex, comms=lee, infra=sam, secondary=maria. running quick checks: tails, error traces.
alex (oncall): diagnostic commands im running:
```
# check 5xx rate from logs (last 5m)
kubectl logs -l app=hosted-inference --since=5m | jq -r .status | grep 5.. | wc -l
# check per-route qps and p50/p95
curl -s http://metrics.internal/api/query?service=hosted-inference | jq .routes
```
incident-bot: PAGED • Escalation to P1 acknowledged by alex (oncall) • paging group: eng-oncall • page ts: 1779994380
maria (handoff): FYI — i collected a couple of sample request IDs with bad traces: req_8a3f, req_8a4b. root cause suspects: sudden KV-cache eviction + routing fallback to CPU-quantized model. see logs in /vault/logs/hosted/17799943.tar.gz
lee (sre-comm): draft note for status.redwood: "We are investigating elevated 5xx rates affecting hosted inference for some customers. Mitigation in progress. No data exfiltration. We'll post updates every 15 minutes." want any specific customer-facing numbers?
alex (oncall): include that affected tenants may see latency spikes and increased error rates; were rolling partial fallback to a stable variant in the next 10-15m, which should reduce errors while we stabilize. no ETA for full resolution yet.
sam (infra): quick infra check: autoscaler flapped due to GPU mem pressure 1779994300-1779994350. some pods restarted and rejoined but there was a brief routing mismatch to CPU fallback pool. im attaching the placement diff: (summary) GPU pool reduced by 2 nodes due to OOMs.
lee (sre-comm): posting status update now -> status.redwood/incident/1779994321 posted. slack ping to customer success and affected tenants channel.
alex (oncall): immediate mitigation step: 1) pin high-traffic tenants to stable-variant-v2 (no quantization) 2) increase GPU pool by 2 nodes (sam to action) 3) enable short KV-cache grace window to avoid eviction storms. doing 1) now:
```
# pin route for tenant-xyz
./control-plane route update --tenant tenant-xyz --model stable-variant-v2 --reason "handoff mitigate"
```
sam (infra): scaling GPU pool +2 now. tracking: scale request id scale-1779994399. ETA ~90s for nodes to register.
maria (handoff): alex — before i drop, ill leave runbook notes: under steps "mitigate transient 5xx" follow pins + scale. if errors recover to <3% for 10m, roll back pins. if not, escalate to platform-eng.
alex (oncall): noted. @lee please keep a short update every 15m, and post any billing/customer impact if noticeable.
lee (sre-comm): got it. first update in ~10m after scale completes. drafting message for CS: "Were mitigating an elevated error rate impacting model responses; mitigation in progress, scaled capacity and pinned model variants. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."
sam (infra): nodes back, pods rescheduled. quick smoke: synthetic QPS passed, 5xx count dropped ~70% from peak. logs show fewer OOMs.
alex (oncall): good. ill keep mitigation owner until we hit stable <2% errors sustained 10m. maria — you can drop after your final note. thanks for the handoff.
maria (handoff): confirmed — handing to alex fully. ill monitor in background but signing off from primary responsibilities. gl. :thumbsup:
lee (sre-comm): status update posted to customers + internal channels. next update scheduled in 15m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED • Severity=P1 -> Mitigating • last update: 1779994710 • handler: alex (oncall)
alex (oncall): summarizing handoff for the log: owners assigned (mitigation=alex, comms=lee, infra=sam, secondary=maria). runbook used: hosted-inference-spike. key actions: pinned tenants, scaled GPU pool, adjusted KV-cache grace. current state: 5xx reduced ~70%, monitoring for 10m. handoff complete.
lee (sre-comm): acknowledged. will escalate to platform-eng if metrics drift up in next window.
sam (infra): ack. monitoring node health.
alex (oncall): thanks team. if anything urgent ping me directly. closing handoff thread.
